grammarRule.formula: If + Past Simple, Would + V1 (If I had money, I would travel)

explanation.ml: സങ്കൽപ്പങ്ങൾ (Second Conditional) എന്ന വിഷയത്തിൽ If + Past Simple, Would + V1 (If I had money, I would travel) എങ്ങനെ ഉപയോഗിക്കണം എന്ന് വിശദീകരിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Learn how to use If + Past Simple, Would + V1 (If I had money, I would travel) correctly in spoken English.

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: If I had time, I would travel.
goldenTip.en: Golden Rule: Practice 'If I had time, I would travel.' with zero hesitation.

verbs.example: If I had time, I would travel.
If I won, I would buy a house.
If I knew, I would help.
If I had wings, I would fly.
